verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Coinbase Payments exposes its capabilities to external AI agents through an MCP server (`cdp mcp`), Coinbase Wallet MCP, and the Agentic Wallet CLI and skills. None of it documents a built-in AI assistant inside the product that a user can hand tasks to. Serving tools to the user's own external AI is an adjacent capability and does not count toward an in-product assistant, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
